name: slipway-demo
install: bash .slipway/cursor-install.sh && bash .cursor/ensure-toolchain-path.sh && export DOTNET_ROOT="$HOME/.dotnet" PATH="$HOME/.dotnet:$HOME/.dotnet/tools:$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH" && dotnet restore apps/api/Api.sln && test -x apps/web/node_modules/.bin/vitest

terminals.name: api
terminals.command: export DOTNET_ROOT="$HOME/.dotnet" PATH="$HOME/.dotnet:$HOME/.dotnet/tools:$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH" && ASPNETCORE_HTTP_PORTS=8080 dotnet run --project apps/api/src/Api

terminals.name: web
terminals.description: Vite dev server on port 5173; proxies /api to the API
